dedupe_keys.name: korail railway data portal operations resources and station boarding statistics

description: The railway data portal of Korea Railroad Corporation (KORAIL) presents integrated statistics on the national railway operator. It shows railway performance (passengers carried, passenger-kilometres, freight tonnes and rolling stock), resources, facilities and staff (operating length by year, vehicles, tunnels, accessibility facilities at stations), boarding and alighting statistics by station for the Gyeongbu, Honam, Gyeongjeon, Jeolla and Gangneung lines and the five major cities, a list of public data, the railway statistical yearbook and total cost figures for fares. Coverage is national (KORAIL network, excluding SRT). The pages are free to view online and the public data list points to downloadable files, with more detail in the yearbook; no licence was stated on the pages read. Caveats: the portal shows the top part of some series and refers to the yearbook for details, and high-speed SRT services are excluded. The statistics support rail demand and capacity planning and disruption analysis on the Korean network. They complement the Korean transit card ridership data and are related to the Deutsche Bahn open data for comparison of operator data portals.
licence: not stated (only a site copyright notice on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
